title: సామెతలు, జాతీయాలు
concept: తెలుగు సామెతలు – అర్థంతో సహా, భావంతో చదవడం

questions.en: Unity is strength.
questions.hi: एकता में बल है।

questions.en: Small bird, big song.
questions.hi: छोटी चिड़िया, ऊँची आवाज़।

questions.en: There is happiness in staying together.
questions.hi: साथ रहने में सुख है।

questions.en: The anthill built by ants goes to the snakes.
questions.hi: चींटियों की बनाई बाँबी साँपों के काम आती है।

questions.en: Pull the vine and the whole bush moves.
questions.hi: बेल खींची तो पूरी झाड़ी हिल गई।

questions.en: Delay turns nectar into poison.
questions.hi: देरी से अमृत भी विष बन जाता है।

questions.en: Distant hills look smooth.
questions.hi: दूर के ढोल सुहावने।

questions.en: Slow and steady is what matters.
questions.hi: धीरज ही सबसे ज़रूरी है।

questions.en: A tiny lamp gives mountain-sized light.
questions.hi: छोटा सा दीपक, पहाड़ जितनी रोशनी।

questions.en: Too much of anything is bad.
questions.hi: अति हर जगह वर्जित है।

questions.en: Win at home first, then win outside.
questions.hi: पहले घर जीतो, फिर बाहर जीतो।

questions.en: Even mother will not serve unless you ask.
questions.hi: बिना माँगे माँ भी खाना नहीं देती।

questions.text: పరుగెత్తి పాలు తాగడం కంటే నిలబడి నీళ్ళు తాగడం మేలు.
accept: పరుగెత్తి పాలు తాగడం కంటే నిలబడి నీళ్ళు తాగడం మేలు.
questions.en: Better to drink water standing than milk while running.
questions.hi: दौड़कर दूध पीने से खड़े होकर पानी पीना अच्छा।

questions.en: Hold the umbrella that suits the sun.
questions.hi: जैसी धूप, वैसा छाता।

questions.en: Do not harm others, or you will be harmed.
questions.hi: दूसरों का बुरा करोगे तो खुद बुरा पाओगे।

questions.en: A full pot does not spill.
questions.hi: भरा घड़ा छलकता नहीं।

questions.en: In bad times the mind goes wrong.
questions.hi: विनाश काले विपरीत बुद्धि।

questions.text: అందరికీ శకునం చెప్పే బల్లి కుడితిలో పడింది.
accept: అందరికీ శకునం చెప్పే బల్లి కుడితిలో పడింది.
questions.en: The lizard that told everyone's fortune fell into the trough.
questions.hi: सबका शगुन बताने वाली छिपकली खुद नाद में गिरी।

questions.text: ఆరు నెలలు సావాసం చేస్తే వారు వీరవుతారు.
accept: ఆరు నెలలు సావాసం చేస్తే వారు వీరవుతారు.
questions.en: Six months together and people become alike.
questions.hi: छह महीने साथ रहो तो एक जैसे बन जाते हैं।

questions.en: Like a monkey getting a coconut.
questions.hi: बंदर के हाथ नारियल लगना।

questions.text: ఆకలి రుచి ఎరుగదు, నిద్ర సుఖం ఎరుగదు.
accept: ఆకలి రుచి ఎరుగదు, నిద్ర సుఖం ఎరుగదు.
questions.en: Hunger knows no taste, sleep knows no comfort.
questions.hi: भूख स्वाद नहीं देखती, नींद आराम नहीं देखती।

questions.en: A person without learning is like a strange animal.
questions.hi: विद्या के बिना मनुष्य पशु समान है।

questions.en: With effort people become sages.
questions.hi: मेहनत हो तो इंसान ऋषि बन जाता है।

questions.en: Can one who cannot jump to the hanging pot fly to heaven?
questions.hi: जो छींके तक नहीं उछल सकती, वह स्वर्ग तक उड़ेगी?

questions.en: Like selling fruits in the name of the tree.
questions.hi: पेड़ का नाम लेकर फल बेचना।

questions.en: The bull's wound is a treat for the crow.
questions.hi: बैल का घाव कौए को प्यारा।

questions.en: All that glitters is not gold.
questions.hi: हर चमकती चीज़ सोना नहीं होती।

questions.en: For the needy, rice water is a feast.
questions.hi: गरीब के लिए माँड़ ही खीर है।

questions.en: The crocodiles' festival is still ahead.
questions.hi: असली मुसीबत तो अभी आगे है।

questions.en: Experience is the real teacher.
questions.hi: अनुभव ही सच्चा गुरु है।
